command_args:
source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source /ros_ws/install/setup.bash
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
export PYTHONPATH=/work/src/oomwoo_sim_support:/work/src/oomwoo_coverage:${PYTHONPATH:-}
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 LP_NUM_THREADS=2
export MAX_WALL_TIME_S=1800 CLOCK_DEAD_WALL_S=45 RUNS=1
python3 - <<'PROVENANCE'
from pathlib import Path
from ament_index_python.packages import get_package_share_directory
import hashlib,json
from oomwoo_coverage import coverage_planner_node as planner
from oomwoo_sim_support import coverage_regression_runner as scorer
share=Path(get_package_share_directory('oomwoo_sim_support'));r={'planner':planner.__file__,'scorer':scorer.__file__,'files':{}}
for name in ['launch/coverage_regression.launch.py','launch/sim_bringup.launch.py','worlds/test_room.world','config/nav2_params.yaml','maps/test_room.yaml','maps/test_room.pgm']:
 a=(share/name).read_bytes();b=(Path('/work/src/oomwoo_sim_support')/name).read_bytes();r['files'][name]={'match':a==b,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest()}
 assert a==b,name
assert planner.__file__.startswith('/work/') and scorer.__file__.startswith('/work/')
print('OOMWOO_SOURCE_PROVENANCE '+json.dumps(r),flush=True)
PROVENANCE
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then exit 3; fi
bash -n /work/deploy/run_coverage_regression.sh || exit 3
bash /work/deploy/run_coverage_regression.sh executor:=reactive
bank_code=$?
export OOMWOO_BANK_CODE=$bank_code
python3 - <<'INNER'
import json,glob,os
from pathlib import Path
r={'bank_code':int(os.environ['OOMWOO_BANK_CODE']),'reports':{},'logs':{}}
for p in glob.glob('/tmp/coverage_runs.*/run*.json'):
 r['reports'][p]=json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
for p in glob.glob('/tmp/coverage_regression.log.*'):
 r['logs'][p]=Path(p).read_text(errors='replace')
r['cgroup']={str(p):p.read_text() for p in [Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/pids.events'),Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/pids.peak'),Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak')] if p.exists()}
print('OOMWOO_GAZEBO_BANK '+json.dumps(r))

interpretation: Existing acceptance checks coverage>=90% and efficiency>=80% at the first 90% crossing. The completed run passes that exact condition: 98.00% final coverage, 90.34% efficiency at target, 74.43% final efficiency. Do not describe final efficiency as90.34%.

Scorer time-to-target439.0s and meter target timestamp434.785s use different accounting start/observation points. Total wall562.71s includes bringup and teardown; do not equate either clock with the other.

The evaluated denominator is13696 serviceable cells with the meter default0.15m edge margin deferred to floor-care. This is not a claim that98% of all physical floor, walls or furniture edges were cleaned.
Two reactive no-progress skips follow successful Nav2 goals closely in the log. Review whether a row watchdog retains a prior segment timestamp across a transit; logs alone do not prove the cause.
Gap-fill passes1-3 each list6 spots at98% and are consumed within0.6s. This may merit examining candidate admission/skipping rather than claiming the last2% was physically visited.
limits: Single test_room scene/run only. No living_room, tall-room, A/B with nav2 executor, statistical reliability or speedup claim.

Local launches/world/map/config match running resources by hashes; sim_bringup is a read-only input bind. No colcon build, dependency install, permission change, source mutation during the run or Keepout build retry.

Keepout mask is empty. This does not validate Keepout filtering, reactive-mask exclusion, lost/future localization, dropped callbacks, three-way relay integration, single-writer authority, docking or MCU watchdog.
Not a physical robot test, ARM throughput, power use, minimum SBC/RAM recommendation or stopping-distance measurement.

ROS2 Launch cleanly closed planner and Nav2 nodes, and escalated its own Gazebo process from SIGINT to SIGTERM after5s. Container auto-removed at terminal completion. No global process search/shell kill, push, PR, merge or maintainer message.
